rationale: OC-ONT-6 + OC-ONT-7. (1) Objective-C spells lightweight generics and protocol adoption with ONE token sequence: in `@interface Cache <KeyType, ObjectType> : Store <KeyType, ObjectType> <CacheProtocol>` the first list is this class's TYPE PARAMETERS, the second is the superclass's TYPE ARGUMENTS and only the third is an adoption list. The pinned grammar emits `parameterized_arguments` for all three, and reading every one as an adoption list published `implements Cache -> KeyType` / `-> ObjectType` — 7 fabricated edges over the 322 admitted corpus files (11 member slots before per-file dedup), against 100 real protocol lists of which zero names a type parameter. A class EXTENSION re-declares the same type parameters in front of its `()`, and a CATEGORY's genuine protocol list sits after its `(` — the two positions are mirror images, so the rule is positional and both cases are pinned here. (2) Honesty §4.1 requires a machine-readable reason code on every relationship below confidence 1.0. The lane shipped 18,794 such rows with a number and no code (8,077 calls / 9,307 uses / 902 references / 508 instantiates); each producer now names what is unresolved about its own row. `contains`/`exports`/`extends`/`implements` sit at 1.0 and must carry no code. OC-E BINDING SPELLING (family contract, DARTD8; `BINDING_SEP` + `metadata.localBinding`, src/ast/types.ts:190). A unit-local read names a binding, not a declaration: the store publishes no parameters or locals, so the bare name could never be answered, and where a same-named declaration existed elsewhere in the project the read was bound to THAT declaration. The pin below is the spelling the analyzer actually emits, read off `binding-spelling-dump.ts`. Pre-change copy preserved as `generics-and-reason-codes.expectation.superseded-fb93f6f18.json`.
